name: VolunteerAvailabilityPlanner
tagline: The Volunteer Availability Planner lets each volunteer show which days and times they can usually serve.
description: The Volunteer Availability Planner lets each volunteer show which days and times they can usually serve. They tap slots on a simple week grid, see the ★ service times the church or charity most needs, say how often they can serve and switch on a break when they need rest. The roster coordinator gets clean, consistent availability on every volunteer record.
features: A day x time-slot grid (a day-by-day list on phones) with service times marked
Quick picks (Weekends, Weekday evenings, Service times, Clear)
A break / sabbatical switch with an end date
A readable summary and Power Fx outputs and events
Writes the chosen slots as text such as Sun:Morning
